name: Beat the Beast: Quetzalcoatl's Trial
review:
Beat the Beast: Quetzalcoatl's Trial is a jungle-temple slot whose bonus game includes wild collection, symbol upgrades and a five-level free spins mode.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 5,555x cap and a 96.16% RTP. Climbing the levels is what the game is about.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
